trigger: Pinned first EEG SHA is correct and MNE/manual header readers agree exactly, but decoded channel standard deviations are tens to hundreds of volts. The physical units/conversion provenance cannot be established from searched primary release/author sources.
decision_type: Coordinator implementation/scientific interpretation amendment within authorized dataset scope; not a new quoted human authorization
prior_protocol: Preserve the header-unit-only PLAN and COORDINATOR_PLAN_REVIEW_01.json as earlier design. No claims of completing that fixed-gain protocol.
revised_estimand: Prospectively frozen external comparison of four fixed source-trained models with one common per-record unlabeled offline gain calibration; conditional on the shared story/speaker. Not uncalibrated zero-shot transfer, physical unit repair, or evidence of a continuity mechanism.

formula.input: X:64 by T after frozen bad-channel template mapping, CAR, high-pass and64Hz resampling, using the mechanically fixed EEG/audio common support
formula.source_amplitude: sqrt(mean(original_TRAIN_std**2)) from the existing frozen normalization file
formula.gain: source_amplitude/record_amplitude, one positive scalar for the whole record
formula.apply: Multiply all X by gain, then existing float32/original TRAIN mean/std/float32 model preprocessing
formula.guards: Nonfinite or <=0 record amplitude is a mechanical input failure before prediction; no tunable clamp or thresholds
formula.testable_property: Invariant to a positive overall input unit multiplier; preserves relative within-record channel amplitudes

prohibited: No target/envelope/prediction values used to choose calibration
No gain grid, per-model adapter, performance-selected scales, or per-channel recalibration
No changes to original TRAIN normalization or frozen model/readout parameters
No physical-microvolt claim for calibrated values
No reinterpretation as online/causal input: calibration uses the full record
No reopening previous tests or adding models

evidence.interpretation: Agreement validates declared header parsing only. Difference in source and target amplitude also mixes raw/preprocessed domains and is not evidence for any exact SI correction.

independent_reader_report.conclusion: Independent software reports the same abnormal amplitude and agreement with MNE. Its approximate million-fold explanation is a hypothesis, not conversion provenance.

author_source_checked.finding: Uses MNE, filtering/resampling/CAR and later segment standardization; does not establish physical units.

not_unit_evidence: OpenNeuro CHANGES says redo EEG files but provides no unit conversion explanation
Initial repository trees contain no conversion source
Other later papers' Dryad loaders use128Hz inputs and contradictory scaling; not the512Hz pinned export chain
No new upstream EEG payload was obtained

timing: Decision made before any new-dataset model prediction or score. Only authorized acquisition, metadata, canary units, audio envelopes and mechanical masks have been inspected.
next_actions: Executor preserves prior documents, implements this sole input-calibration amendment, checks synthetic positive-unit invariance and existing canary without model inference, then proceeds with the380record acquisition/processing. Final model/config/source/mask/statistical freeze is reviewed before one evaluation.
